exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-22T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix mail-

exec card --actor scheduler mail send worker old
at 2026-07-22T12:30:00Z
exec card --actor scheduler mail send worker recent
at 2026-07-22T12:45:00Z
exec card --actor scheduler mail send observer observed

# Global selection applies age and limit without changing mailbox read state.
at 2026-07-22T13:00:00Z
exec card --actor auditor --json mail recv --global --age 45m --limit 2
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/global.jsonl

# Clear applies the actor selection and leaves unselected mail available.
exec card --actor worker --json mail recv --clear --age 45m --limit 1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/cleared.json
exec card --actor worker --json mail recv
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/old.jsonl
exec card --actor worker --json mail recv --all
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/worker-all.jsonl
exec card --actor observer --json mail recv --peek
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/observer.jsonl

-- golden/global.jsonl --

{"id":"mail_00000000000000000000000000000003","sender":"scheduler","recipient":"observer","source_topic":null,"body":"observed","created":"2026-07-22T12:45:00Z","expires":"2026-07-29T12:45:00Z","read_at":null}
